dct_description_sm:
Contains all data for the maps "Boundary Changes, 1670-2001" and "Newfoundland Joins Confederation, 1949" from Unit 17: Territorial Evolution, 1670-2001 in the Historical Atlas of Canada Online Learning Project.

Data is best viewed in tree view. It is divided into shapefiles, arcmap documents, and supporting documents, including data tables, legends, and snapshots of the maps as displayed on the website.
For documentation explaining the data, see the file:
"HACOLP_Territorial_Evolution_Distribution_Info_20161205.pdf".
This document gives the locations within the file structure for data pertaining to the different maps
